_comment: All 5 Vasooli workflows merged into one importable file, so a single Active toggle covers the whole system: [Vasooli 01 - Intake Handler] Receives normalized ElevenLabs intake data and creates an invoice in the backend. Buyer phone number doubles as the Breeth buyerId since the API has no separate buyer_id field. | [Vasooli 02 - Daily Scheduler] Runs daily to advance the legal clock on unpaid invoices and hand each one to the escalation ladder. Payment confirmation is not polled here: Dodo pushes /api/webhooks/dodo directly on success, which is the source of truth for the paid status. | [Vasooli 03 - Escalation Ladder] Branches on the invoice status the backend already derived from days_elapsed (nudged/noticed/overdue), instead of re-checking day thresholds here, so the escalation ladder has one source of truth. The 'ElevenLabs API' n8n credential must send the xi-api-key header (ElevenLabs' auth header, not Authorization). | [Vasooli 04 - Post Call Handler] Receives ElevenLabs post-call data, persists it, and records buyer intent in Breeth. Looks up the invoice first because the call webhook only carries invoice_id, not the buyer phone number Breeth keys memory on. | [Vasooli 05 - Complaint Generator] Generates the statutory Samadhaan complaint PDF and marks the workflow outcome.
name: Vasooli Agent - All Workflows

parameters.content: Validate Hindi voice intake, store invoice, then persist memory keyed by buyer phone.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { buyer_name: $json.buyer_name, buyer_phone: $json.buyer_phone, buyer_email: $json.buyer_email, invoice_number: $json.invoice_number, amount: $json.amount, invoice_date: $json.invoice_date, language: $json.language || "hi" } }}

={{ { jsonrpc: "2.0", id: Date.now(), method: "tools/call", params: { name: "store_memory", arguments: { buyerId: $json.buyer_phone, intent: "invoice_context", content: { invoice_id: $json.invoice_id, invoice_number: $json.invoice_number, amount: $json.amount, due_date: $json.due_date } } } } }}

parameters.content: Daily: list unpaid invoices, add a day, let the backend derive the escalation status, then trigger workflow 03 per invoice.
nudged/noticed -> outbound reminder call. overdue -> refresh the Samadhaan complaint draft. pending/called/paid -> no action this cycle.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { agent_id: $env.ELEVENLABS_OUTBOUND_AGENT_ID, agent_phone_number_id: $env.ELEVENLABS_OUTBOUND_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, to_number: $json.buyer_phone, conversation_initiation_client_data: { dynamic_variables: { msme_name: $json.msme_name, buyer_name: $json.buyer_name, invoice_number: $json.invoice_number, amount: $json.amount, days_elapsed: $json.days_elapsed, escalation_stage: $json.status } } } }}

parameters.content: Persist outbound call outcome, then remember the buyer's promise/dispute keyed by phone number.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { invoice_id: $('Post Call Webhook').item.json.invoice_id, direction: $('Post Call Webhook').item.json.direction, transcript: $('Post Call Webhook').item.json.transcript, outcome: $('Post Call Webhook').item.json.outcome, promise_date: $('Post Call Webhook').item.json.promise_date, duration_seconds: $('Post Call Webhook').item.json.duration_seconds } }}

={{ { jsonrpc: "2.0", id: Date.now(), method: "tools/call", params: { name: "store_memory", arguments: { buyerId: $('Get Invoice').item.json.buyer_phone, intent: "call_outcome", content: { invoice_id: $('Post Call Webhook').item.json.invoice_id, outcome: $('Post Call Webhook').item.json.outcome, promise_date: $('Post Call Webhook').item.json.promise_date } } } } }}

parameters.content: Fetch complaint PDF after the filing threshold and notify the MSME.
